name: code-buddy
description: A coding companion that watches your editor, notices when you're stuck, and gives you the logic (not just the answer).

commands.title: Code Buddy: Set Anthropic API Key
Code Buddy: I'm Stuck - Help Me

codeBuddy.model.description: Anthropic model used by the companion.

codeBuddy.stuckSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity (while the file has problems or an unfinished area) before the companion thinks you're stuck.

codeBuddy.persistentErrorSeconds.description: If the same errors stay for this long while you keep editing, the companion offers help.

codeBuddy.autoHint.description: When stuck is detected, automatically generate a gentle nudge instead of only offering one.

codeBuddy.maxContextLines.description: Max lines of code sent to the model per request (window around your cursor for big files).

codeBuddy.ignoreGlobs.description: Files whose contents are never sent to the model.
